pool.logistic-regression.name: Logistic regression
pool.logistic-regression.what: A weighted sum of the predictors, turned into a chance. The plain baseline.
pool.logistic-regression.pre: Numbers: median fill and scaling. Categories: most-frequent fill and one-hot.

pool.logistic-regression-isotonic-calibr.name: Logistic regression (isotonic calibrated)
pool.logistic-regression-isotonic-calibr.what: Logistic regression, recalibrated by isotonic scaling fitted on inner folds.
pool.logistic-regression-isotonic-calibr.pre: Numbers: median fill and scaling. Categories: most-frequent fill and one-hot.

pool.logistic-regression-platt-calibrate.name: Logistic regression (platt calibrated)
pool.logistic-regression-platt-calibrate.what: Logistic regression, recalibrated by Platt scaling fitted on inner folds.
pool.logistic-regression-platt-calibrate.pre: Numbers: median fill and scaling. Categories: most-frequent fill and one-hot.

pool.random-forest.name: Random Forest
pool.random-forest.what: Hundreds of decision trees, each on a random slice, averaged.
pool.random-forest.pre: Numbers: median fill. Categories: coded as integers the trees split on.

pool.random-forest-isotonic-calibrated.name: Random Forest (isotonic calibrated)

pool.random-forest-isotonic-calibrated.pre: Numbers: median fill. Categories: coded as integers the trees split on.

pool.random-forest-platt-calibrated.name: Random Forest (platt calibrated)
pool.random-forest-platt-calibrated.what: Random Forest, recalibrated by Platt scaling fitted on inner folds.
pool.random-forest-platt-calibrated.pre: Numbers: median fill. Categories: coded as integers the trees split on.

pool.xgboost.name: XGBoost
pool.xgboost.what: Trees added one at a time, each correcting the last. The usual accuracy leader.
pool.xgboost.pre: Numbers: median fill. Categories: coded as integers the trees split on.

pool.xgboost-isotonic-calibrated.name: XGBoost (isotonic calibrated)
pool.xgboost-isotonic-calibrated.what: XGBoost, recalibrated by isotonic scaling fitted on inner folds.
pool.xgboost-isotonic-calibrated.pre: Numbers: median fill. Categories: coded as integers the trees split on.

pool.xgboost-platt-calibrated.name: XGBoost (platt calibrated)

pool.xgboost-platt-calibrated.pre: Numbers: median fill. Categories: coded as integers the trees split on.

pool.stacked-ensemble.name: Stacked ensemble
pool.stacked-ensemble.what: A logistic blend of the five best models' predictions on this set.
